title: Ameer Fakher Eldin to Direct Caesar Biopic With Taim Hassan and Neon
excerpt:
The film will dramatize the story of Syrian whistleblower Farid Al-Madhhan.
Taim Hassan will star, with Neon attached for distribution and international partners developing the project.
body_md:
Ameer Fakher Eldin, the filmmaker behind The Stranger and Yunan, is attached to direct Caesar, a biographical feature about Farid Al-Madhhan, the Syrian military police photographer who exposed evidence of torture and deaths in detention under Bashar Assad's government. Syrian actor Taim Hassan has been cast as Al-Madhhan, who became known internationally by the codename Caesar. Neon is involved in distributing the film.

Al-Madhhan worked as a military police photographer and headed a judicial evidence office in Damascus. According to the project's announcement, he secretly helped move more than 50,000 photographs out of Syria. The images documented evidence of abuse, starvation and deaths in detention facilities, and subsequently became significant to European legal efforts involving allegations of war crimes.

The principal creative team was unveiled during an industry event at the Doha Film Festival. Both Hassan and the real Al-Madhhan attended the presentation, making the encounter between the actor and the person he will portray a focal point of the announcement. Al-Madhhan emphasized that the film is intended as a human story rather than simply a forensic reconstruction or documentary exercise. He wants audiences to recognize the people and families behind the evidence.

Hassan is widely known for the Arabic television drama Al Hayba, which reached international viewers through Netflix. His subsequent credits include Taj, Under the Seventh Ground and Mawlana. Fakher Eldin, born in Kyiv to Syrian parents from the Golan Heights, described the enormous responsibility of depicting a person who faced a dangerous moral choice and acted despite potentially devastating consequences.

The screenplay will be written by BAFTA-nominated duo Rory Haines and Sohrab Noshirvani, whose work includes The Mauritanian. Department M and Doha's Katara Studios are developing the project, with support from Kuwait-based Sard Media and participation from Syrian company Tadmor Film City. The project was initially announced at the Doha industry event in 2025, and this latest presentation identifies the director and lead performer.

Although the production partners and principal talent have now been announced, no confirmed filming start, festival premiere or theatrical release date was provided. Producer Mike Larocca expressed hope that the team would be able to report major production milestones at the next edition of the Doha event. The current announcement therefore marks development progress, not completion of the film.
seo_title: Taim Hassan to Star in Ameer Fakher Eldin's Caesar
seo_description: Neon-backed Caesar biopic names Ameer Fakher Eldin as director and Taim Hassan as the Syrian whistleblower.
